verdict.rationale: RingCentral is a developer platform with public API docs, so agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for it. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and nothing in the pack describes docs written for agent consumption. The MCP servers and the 'connect to LLMs' claims belong to separate integration stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
